title: RMLNLU secures BCI approval for 2026-27
description: After a lapse in its approval status that had lasted three academic years, Dr Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University (RMLNLU) at Lucknow now appears on the Bar Council of India's (BCI) list of approved Centres of Legal Education till the 2026-27 academic session.The list shows an intake of 60 students against its five-year BA.LL.B. (Hons) course. However, the college's actual intake for the course is 180 students.Speaking to Bar and Bench, the University's Joint Registrar (Administration, IT
